# Add-ZbxHostTemplate

## SYNOPSIS

Links templates to hosts.

## SYNTAX

```
Add-ZbxHostTemplate [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHost>[]> [-Template] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplate>> [-Force] [-PassThru] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Add-ZbxHostTemplate cmdlet links the template in -Template to the hosts given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped hosts) with host.massadd; the templates already linked stay. Each host then gets the template's items, triggers, graphs, discovery rules and dashboards. The command writes nothing unless -PassThru is given, and needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Link a template to a host

```powershell
Add-ZbxHostTemplate -InputObject 'db-01' -Template 'Web App'
Get-ZbxHost -Name 'db-01' -SelectParentTemplates | ForEach-Object { $_.ParentTemplates.TechnicalName }
```

-InputObject (position 0) takes the host and -Template (position 1) the template, each by name, id or object.

### Example 2: Link a template to every host of a group

```powershell
Get-ZbxHost -Group 'Web servers' | Add-ZbxHostTemplate -Template 'Web App' -PassThru | Select-Object TechnicalName
```

The hosts piped from Get-ZbxHost are linked in one call; -PassThru writes them back.
